task_text: 核查以下声明，搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：A list of notable viral outbreaks between 1950 and 2019 purported to have “originated in China”（声明日期：2020-05-09）
task_text_en: Fact-check the following claim by searching for external evidence. Answer based on the evidence actually obtained, and state the scope of the conclusion and its uncertainties: A list of notable viral outbreaks between 1950 and 2019 purported to have “originated in China” (claim date: 2020-05-09)
